description:
- Expanded addon support for catalogs, streaming sources, subtitles, title details, and episodes.
- Added addon discovery and management under Profile → Addons, with Installed, Official, and Community listings, search, type filters, configuration links, and uninstall controls.
- Install and manage multiple addon providers or configurations independently.
- Play supported direct-video and torrent streams from compatible addons, such as Torrentio, inside Phantom Movies.
- Catalog addons now add Home sections after the original sections. Shelves load as needed for smoother scrolling, and See all opens the full catalog.
- Choose streams from the title page using filters for individual addons and built-in sources. Selecting an episode refreshes its streams, and your chosen source carries into the player.
- Source cards retain addon names and display available quality, seeder counts, and file sizes. The animated Phantom ghost appears while playback loads or buffers.
- Failed or stalled addon streams automatically advance to another available source while preserving your watch position.
- Added optional automatic next-episode playback, while keeping the manual Next episode button available.
- Added torrent performance profiles, optional background playback, and a notification action to stop playback.
- Completed movies and episodes now display red watched checkmarks. Shows are marked once an episode has been watched, and rewatching preserves completion.
- Added a red border around the selected episode and made the download button more compact.
- Improved cross-device sync for favorites, watch history, Continue Watching, and addon configurations, including reconnection and offline retries.
- Improved migration of older favorites and history, synchronized removals, and separation of saved libraries when switching accounts.
- Install over your existing app to keep saved data. Update the TV companion and sign into the same account on both devices to sync your library.

releases.description:
- Fixed the player aspect control. It now switches between Fit, Fill screen, and Zoom.
- Fixed the player screen lock. Playback controls, gestures, and Back are blocked while locked, with an accessible unlock button.
- The selected aspect mode and lock state are preserved when the player is recreated.
releases.body:
- Fixed the player aspect control. It now switches between Fit, Fill screen, and Zoom.
- Fixed the player screen lock. Playback controls, gestures, and Back are blocked while locked, with an accessible unlock button.
- The selected aspect mode and lock state are preserved when the player is recreated.

releases.description:
- Added movie and episode downloads for supported streams, saved directly to Downloads/Phantom Movies on your device.
- Added offline playback from the Downloads page.
- Added download progress, pause, resume, cancel, retry, and Hide controls. Downloads continue while the app is in the background.
- Added quality, audio language, subtitle, and live status details beneath existing server names when available.
- Server details refresh during playback and automatic failover, and failed servers remain available to retry.
- Updated notifications to use the Phantom Movies notification icon.
